stories.title: “This meeting is a farce”: Flintshire councillors vote down nine of ten motions
stories.summary: Calls to act on flooding, school transport, housing development and the cost of a new Catholic school were all voted down at a special meeting of Flintshire County Council on Tuesday. stories.title: Broughton flood work delayed as council rejects call for more defence money
stories.summary: Flood defence work in Broughton that was due to start in the summer has been put back, with a new start now proposed for December or January, a councillor has told Flintshire County Council. stories.title: Fifteen affordable homes and office planned for Garden City
stories.summary: Fifteen affordable homes and a small office are planned for a site next to Sealand Primary School in Garden City. Housing association ClwydAlyn has applied to Flintshire County Council to build nine three-bedroom and six two-bedroom houses on Plot 5 at Northern Gateway, off John Summers Way. stories.title: Power cut in Hawarden, with power expected back by lunchtime
stories.summary: Part of Hawarden has been without power since around 5am this morning, according to SP Energy Networks. The power company expects power to be restored by lunchtime. stories.title: Fifteen Flintshire roads closed today, with Bagillt worst hit
stories.summary: Drivers in Bagillt face four sets of roadworks at once this week, with part of the A5026 closed until Friday. The A5026 at Lyons Den and Bagillt Road is shut for highways maintenance until Friday 20 November, according to Flintshire County Council’s roadworks list.
